faqs.question: What does a jyotishi do in Hindu family life?
faqs.answer: Navdhya explains that a jyotishi studies horoscope patterns, timing, graha influences, and muhurta considerations so families can make more informed ritual and life-planning decisions. Navdhya uses this kind of guidance to help families prepare more clearly, communicate better, and approach the ritual or booking process with greater confidence. faqs.question: Is a jyotishi the same as a pandit?
faqs.answer: Not always. A jyotishi is primarily an astrological advisor, while a pandit or purohit may be more focused on ceremony performance.
